extra_context: Hi, I'm Nora — I photograph weddings on 35mm and medium-format film, mostly for couples who want something quiet and unposed rather than the big flashy gallery look. I work with people getting married in vineyards, old barns, backyards, that kind of thing, usually around Oregon and Northern California. The feeling I'm after is calm and timeless — photos that look like they could've been taken in 1995 or yesterday, that you'd still love hanging on your wall in thirty years. The one thing that sets me apart: I only shoot film, no digital backup camera, and I hand-develop the black and whites myself so the grain and tones are actually mine, not a preset.
